title: application-core objects O1: lib/tests/integration.rs and shop's examples 190-196 with an ordinary receiver made by its constructor
description: Row O1 of llm-dlc/loops/application-core-acceptance.md, at the commit that commits this job (the objects stream's workspace, application-core-objects). O1 lets the regression check (equivalence) and the property check (prove) take an instance method of an ordinary class: the receiver is made by its constructor as an object parameter is (construction::receiver over equivalence::made_of), its fields compared after the call, and 'this' a root of the identity relations. Before, every such method was refused ('is an instance method; ... otherwise only static methods are'). Unit-level tests ran inline on the native engine (tests/application_core.rs's O1, tests/application_core_objects.rs). This job checks what needs JBMC or build.py: step 1 runs lib/tests/integration.rs unchanged (several tests run JBMC; expected: every non-ignored test passes, exit 0). Steps 2-8 rerun examples 190 to 196 (jvmcontract compare, domain and bounds as each example records them, the native engine as recorded): their kernels named Quote#quantity unresolved as an instance method, which O1 now checks, so their recorded kernel lines may change, but each example's top-level verdict must not. Expected: 190 verified, 191 violation, 192 violation, 193 violation, 194 violation, 195 verified, 196 unverifiable, build.py printing 'as expected' and exiting 0 for each. Every step runs even if one fails.
expected: integration tests: every non-ignored test passes (exit 0); examples 190 verified, 191-194 violation, 195 verified, 196 unverifiable, each with build.py printing 'as expected' and exiting 0
